title: Toro Calican
description: Meeting The Mandalorian, Din Djarin, on Tatooine, Toro Calican struck a deal to share a bounty on the notorious assassin Fennec Shand. The pair tracked Shand to the dessert and captured her. Calican shot Shand and left her for dead, then went to Peli Motto's repair bay to ambush Djarin. Djarin turned the tables on Calican and gunned him down.
